metricSemantics.targetImproved: Counts rows that match the selected discovery target. final-improved is attributed only to the terminal override trace with selectedFeatures in each variant.
metricSemantics.terminalFinalImproved: Counts selected terminal override traces with selectedFeatures whose whole variant final outcome improved versus baseline.
metricSemantics.terminalFinalRegressed: Counts selected terminal override traces with selectedFeatures whose whole variant final outcome regressed versus baseline.
metricSemantics.safetyRegressed: Counts selected traces with either a regressed immediate selection outcome or a regressed whole-variant final outcome. Whole-variant final regression is applied to every selected trace in that variant.

v2DeprecatedMetricAliases.note: Schema-v2 compatibility aliases only. Do not use these aliases to reinterpret schema-v1 artifacts, where finalRegressed represented combined safety regression.

cappedAtomSummary.conjunctionReservationSearchDescription: Exhaustive recursive reservation search up to requested --max-group-size; full candidate enumeration honors --max-group-size.
